title: Mapping goal-misgeneralization triggers as a minimal model organism

original_idea.body: A reproducible audit of AI-discovered SMT safety conditions (extends Emergent Formal Verification arXiv:2603.21149): have an open LLM generate Z3/SMT encodings, independently run Z3, tally genuinely-verified vs vacuous specs. Z3 on a laptop.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Independently re-checking AI-generated safety proofs is a strong, concrete oversight chain as AI writes its own proofs.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Open LLM generates Z3 encodings + Z3 checks on a laptop; some SMT familiarity needed but guided.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused tally of genuine vs vacuous specs; defining the property set adds some effort.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent verification of AI-generated proofs is neglected, lab-independent oversight infrastructure.

low_compute.reasoning: Z3 runs on a laptop; LLM inference only.

novelty.reasoning: Very recent paper with a red-flag claim; independent re-checking likely unpublished.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Recent claim; independent vacuity audit likely not yet done.
